mcp_tools.name: defined_flow_auditor
mcp_tools.title: Defined-flow auditor
mcp_tools.description: Submit a zero-trust evidence manifest; get a deterministic DEFINED / NOT_DEFINED / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across seven sections (never trust always verify, identity-based access, least privilege, micro-segmentation, continuous verification, the claim gauntlet, scope and limits) with per-check evidence. One failure breaks the claim.

inputSchema.description: The zero-trust evidence manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table).

system.description: System whose defined flows are audited.

gauntlet.description: Claim-gauntlet evidence (server secrets, breach exposure, backdoors).

expect.notes: All boolean requirements met, including negative constraints (false) and conditional logic (backdoors/NIST).
